description: This file contains core thread creation primitives for ARM64 Cortex-A in the Zephyr RTOS, including thread initialization, user mode entry, and stack management.

methods.name: arch_new_thread
methods.description: Initializes a new thread, setting up its context and stack, and handling user or kernel thread specifics.

methods.name: arch_user_mode_enter
methods.description: Transitions a thread into user mode, setting up the stack and registers for EL0 execution.
